column1: What CSS Grid function creates a responsive column layout that wraps without media queries?
column2: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min, max))

column1: In CSS Grid, what is the difference between auto-fit and auto-fill when there are fewer items than available column tracks?
column2: auto-fit collapses empty tracks to 0px allowing items to expand, whereas auto-fill preserves empty tracks.

column1: What does the minmax(280px, 1fr) track sizing function specify?
column2: The track minimum width is 280px and its maximum width is 1 fractional share of available space.

column1: What does the 1fr unit represent in a CSS Grid container?
column2: One fraction of the remaining free space available in the grid track container.

column1: What is the default value of align-items on a CSS Grid container?
column2: stretch (all grid items in a row expand to match the height of the tallest item).

column1: How does align-items: stretch in CSS Grid enable equal-height card components?
column2: It automatically stretches each child item to 100% of the computed grid cell track height.

column1: In a flex container with flex-direction: column, how does margin-top: auto on a child element behave?
column2: It consumes all remaining vertical free space in the flex container, pushing the element to the very bottom.

column1: Why does margin-top: auto on .service-cta keep buttons aligned across cards with unequal text lengths?
column2: Because the parent card is stretched to full grid height, allowing auto margin to absorb leftover vertical space.

column1: When should you choose CSS Grid over CSS Flexbox?
column2: Use CSS Grid for 2-dimensional layouts (rows and columns simultaneously), and Flexbox for 1-dimensional flows (single row or single column).

column1: Why is role="list" added to a <ul> element that has list-style: none in CSS?
column2: Safari VoiceOver removes list semantics when list-style: none is applied; role="list" restores accessibility announcement.

column1: Why should decorative inline SVG icons carry aria-hidden="true"?
column2: To prevent assistive screen readers from announcing redundant, unhelpful vector coordinate data.

column1: How does aria-labelledby="service-title-1" on an <article> improve accessibility?
column2: It uses the inner text of the referenced heading element as the accessible name for that article landmark.

column1: What is the purpose of the CSS media query @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)?
column2: It ensures hover micro-interactions only execute on devices with a fine pointer (like a mouse) rather than touchscreens.

column1: What bug occurs on mobile touchscreens when card hover effects are not wrapped in a hover media query?
column2: Tapping the card triggers a persistent synthetic hover state that leaves buttons stuck in their highlighted appearance.

column1: Why should a list item with a bullet icon use align-items: flex-start instead of align-items: center?
column2: To keep the bullet icon pinned to the top-left baseline when the adjacent text wraps across multiple lines.

column1: Why is transition: all considered a CSS performance anti-pattern?
column2: It forces the browser to evaluate every animatable property during repaints, including expensive layout-triggering properties.

column1: Which specific CSS properties can the browser animate purely on the GPU Compositor thread?
column2: transform and opacity (they bypass the Layout/Reflow and Paint stages).

column1: What is the purpose of outline-offset: 2px on a focused interactive element?
column2: It creates visual negative space between the element's border and the focus ring, enhancing visibility.

column1: What does WCAG 2.1 Success Criterion 2.4.7 require for keyboard navigation?
column2: Any keyboard-operable user interface must have a clearly visible focus indicator.

column1: How does stroke="currentColor" on an SVG path work in CSS?
column2: The SVG stroke dynamically inherits the computed value of the CSS color property of its parent element.

column1: What security vulnerability does rel="noopener noreferrer" prevent on target="_blank" links?
column2: Reverse tabnabbing (where the target page gains access to window.opener and can redirect the origin tab to phishing URLs).

column1: How does the CSS ::before pseudo-element create custom deliverable checkmark badges?
column2: It inserts generated content with display: inline-flex, background color, and border-radius before the element text.

column1: Why is flex-shrink: 0 required on a fixed-width ::before icon badge inside a flex container?
column2: To prevent the browser from shrinking or squishing the badge when adjacent text expands in narrow viewports.

column1: How do data-action and data-context attributes support zero-framework architecture?
column2: They encode behavioral intent and context directly into the DOM for centralized event delegation without inline JS handlers.
